capabilities: Sync WeRead book metadata, highlights, thoughts, reviews and popular marks
Batch import book lists by pasting titles and matching WeRead editions
Create independent personal reading notes linked to books
Import Markdown, TXT and DOCX notes with paragraphs, tables and images
Browse bookshelf and reading statistics pages listing all notes
disambiguation: Not a separate vault or official WeRead product; it organizes reading data inside your existing Obsidian vault.
extras: Not yet in the Obsidian community plugin store; install via GitHub Release or BRAT. Desktop only (macOS, Windows, Linux) because login uses an Electron window. Manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README includes detailed privacy disclosures: no telemetry, no paid features, credentials stored only in local plugin config.
intentEvidence: 基于 zhaohongxuan/obsidian-weread-plugin 二次开发
motivation: Built as a second development of zhaohongxuan/obsidian-weread-plugin, keeping its WeRead sync while adding book list import, independent personal notes, and external file import.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull WeRead reading data into the vault or manage paper book lists and reading notes alongside synced highlights.

summary: Reading-knowledge plugin that syncs WeRead books, highlights and reviews, imports paper book lists, and keeps personal reading notes as separate Markdown files.
